title: Molecular logics in dual sensor regulation of enzyme activity – Phosphorylation OR blue-light activation of cyanobacterial diguanylate cyclases
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蓝藻双传感器DGC酶活性调控，聚焦磷酸化与蓝光信号整合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bacterial cells use multiple environmental cues to regulate levels of the second messenger cyclic dimeric GMP. This compound influences key lifestyle decisions such as motility, biofilm formation, or virulence. Although many diguanylate cyclases (DGCs) combined with various sensory domains have been studied previously, how distinct inputs are integrated within a single enzyme remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigate a cyanobacterial family of dual-sensor DGCs that combine an N-terminal receiver (Rec) domain followed by a light-oxygen-voltage (LOV) domain upstream of a diguanylate cyclase (GGDEF) domain. Using in vivo activity screening and in vitro characterisation, we determined how phosphorylation and blue light, individually and jointly, regulate enzyme activity. By measuring kinetic parameters across four defined functional states, unphosphorylated or phosphorylated, in combination with dark or light states, we reveal logic gate-like behaviours. One representative, La RldC, integrates both signals with pronounced fold-changes in activity-, consistent with overall OR-type logic and with light acting as the dominant input. Our results demonstrate its function as a molecular gate coupling phosphorylation and illumination sensing to cyclic-di-GMP formation. These findings provide valuable insights into multi-signal decision-making in cyanobacteria and establish further understanding of how modular sensory domains are wired to control bacterial second-messenger signalling.
abstract_zh: 细菌细胞利用多种环境线索来调节第二信使环二鸟苷酸的水平。该化合物影响关键的生活方式决策，如运动性、生物膜形成或毒力。尽管此前已研究了多种结合不同传感结构域的二鸟苷酸环化酶（DGCs），但不同输入如何在单一酶内整合仍未被完全理解。在此，我们研究了一个蓝藻家族的双传感器DGCs，其结构包含N端接收（Rec）结构域，随后是光-氧-电压（LOV）结构域，位于二鸟苷酸环化酶（GGDEF）结构域上游。通过体内活性筛选和体外表征，我们确定了磷酸化和蓝光如何单独及联合调节酶活性。通过测量四种明确功能状态下的动力学参数，即未磷酸化或磷酸化，结合暗态或光态，我们揭示了类似逻辑门的行为。一个代表性成员La RldC整合了两种信号，并表现出显著的活性倍数变化，这与整体OR型逻辑一致，且光作为主导输入。我们的结果证明其作为分子门的功能，将磷酸化和光照感知耦合至环二鸟苷酸的形成。这些发现为蓝藻中的多信号决策提供了宝贵见解，并进一步加深了对模块化传感结构域如何连接以控制细菌第二信使信号传导的理解。
